description: This file defines an abstract class 'CRC' for computing and manipulating CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) values, including methods for extending, zero-extension, unextension, concatenation, scrambling, and obtaining a CRC instance for CRC32C. It also includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: CRC
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface for CRC computations, including methods for CRC manipulation and a singleton accessor for CRC32C.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Sets the CRC of an empty string.

methods.name: Extend
methods.description: Extends a CRC with additional bytes.

methods.name: ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends a CRC with zero bytes.

methods.name: UnextendByZeroes
methods.description: Removes zero bytes from the end of a CRC.

methods.name: Scramble
methods.description: Applies a non-linear transformation to a CRC for safety.

methods.name: Crc32c
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of CRC for CRC32C polynomial.
